stem: Esha views a cylinder from the side and sees a rectangular profile. She asks whether only a cylinder can show that rectangle from a chosen viewpoint.

options.text: A rectangular side profile can come from more than one solid, not only from a cylinder.
Any solid shows a rectangle from the side, so the viewpoint need not be checked.
The rectangular outline is what chooses the viewpoint, rather than the viewpoint shaping the profile.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A profile depends on the viewpoint, and the same rectangular outline can fit more than one solid, not only a cylinder.

teacher.key_rationale: A requested outline may be produced by more than one solid; a cylinder’s side rectangle is not unique to cylinders. Ignoring the viewpoint omits a required condition. Saying the outline chooses the viewpoint reverses the relation.
